title: Imported term text that matches no term is saved as sent
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a contacts import file with one new customer, customer A, whose credit term is "Prepaid", a text that matches no term.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Import the file through Settings, Data Import, Contacts.
  2. Open customer A's customer page.
  3. Open Edit Customer.
  4. Close Edit Customer without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The import finishes.
  • No row is refused because of its credit term.

Step 2:

  • The "Credit term" reads "Prepaid" exactly as sent.

Step 3:

  • "Prepaid" shows selected after the active terms, without "(Inactive)".

Step 4:

  • Nothing changes.
  • The import showed no new error message.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer), story SV-11679 (Story 10, Imports and Public API)

  • S10-R4: “Any other text is saved exactly as sent and dates invoices as it does today (lenient, as today).”
  • S10-N1: “Imports and the Public API never refuse a row or a request because of its credit term.”
  • Key Decisions: “Imports and the Public API stay lenient. A blank term gets the default; a name matching any of the shop's terms (standard or its own, active or deactivated, ignoring capitals and spaces) is saved as that term in its correct spelling, and a deactivated one then shows as "{name} (Inactive)"; any other text is saved as sent and dated as today.”
  • S5-E2: “A customer whose stored term is text ShopView does not know (from an old import) shows that text selected in Edit Customer, after the active terms, without "(Inactive)".”
  • Story 10, Error Handling: “None new. Import and API errors are unchanged.”
